jurisdiction.label: Spain manufacturing production index, seasonally and calendar adjusted, 2021=100

design_exposure_boundary.exposed_before_this_exact_freeze: 2025-01 through 2026-06 values and provisional flags were visible during bounded schema adjudication
design_exposure_boundary.consequence: The July 2026 target forecast is prospective because its outcome is absent, but this first freeze is not claimed as a design-blind holdout. The prior probe is excluded from fit and score; a fresh post-preregistration response supplies the campaign state.

transform.reason: positive index and multiplicative monthly movement

M1.point_rule: local expanding drift on monthly log changes

model_availability.seasonality: NOT_ACTIVATED_IN_THIS_SPECIFIC_FIRST_FREEZE; no post-probe seasonal estimator is invented

weights.prequential_learning: begins only after the July outcome is independently captured and scored

predictive_distributions.M0: Student-t for next log index induced by the fixed-zero-mean innovation and inverse-gamma posterior
predictive_distributions.M1: Student-t posterior predictive for next log index under Normal-Inverse-Gamma drift
predictive_distributions.interval: central 90 percent in log-index space mapped monotonically to index points
predictive_distributions.point: predictive median mapped to index points

future_scoring.log_score: Student-t log density of log(index_actual) minus log(index_actual) Jacobian
future_scoring.CRPS: computed on log-index predictive distribution; no claim of CRPS on the exponentiated Student-t scale

support_and_recovery.revision_policy: future source revisions are separate vintages and never overwrite this freeze
support_and_recovery.euroind_vtg_boundary: ei_is_m_vtg is retained as revision evidence only because its NACE B-D target includes excluded energy, gas and electricity

abort_gates: target 2026-07 appears in the acquisition response
dimension identity differs from the frozen jurisdiction
training months are non-contiguous or fewer than 36
any index value is zero, negative or missing
response bytes cannot be hashed and persisted before prediction
